title: Reduce telemetry flat WebView exports
summary: Removed telemetryView flat window aliases while preserving the mediaPipelineTelemetryView namespace and refreshed WebView guard baselines.
reason: The WebView cleanup workstream is reducing transitional flat window exports by touched domain. Telemetry callers already use the namespace, so the flat aliases were unnecessary compatibility surface.
behavior_before: Telemetry exposed renderTelemetry, renderGpuRows, telemetryVisibleGpuRows, telemetryReadinessLines, and telemetryReadinessStatus both through window.mediaPipelineTelemetryView and as flat window functions.
behavior_after: Telemetry exposes those functions through window.mediaPipelineTelemetryView only; the browser smoke now asserts namespace-first access and the global export inventory records zero telemetry flat exports.
manual_validation: npm run webview:prework:check - blocked before edits at webview:lint:budget:check because the current workspace warning budget is already above baseline (729 > 664); webview:check portion passed
rollback_plan: Restore the five telemetry window alias assignments and regenerate the WebView public contract, split candidates, inventory, and summaries if a downstream compatibility caller is found.
